title: E01 模型半：工具 schema 的存在税（全量 vs 最小工具集）
hypothesis: 只挂核心工具 schema 的臂，在质量非劣的前提下降低每任务 token 与首 token 延迟
not_run_reason: preregistration lands before the paid run so the exposure pair and the rule cannot be chosen after seeing results

task_cluster_definition.cluster: full tool schema vs minimal tool set (read,edit,write,bash); one factor differs
task_cluster_definition.independence: task is the sampling unit; tasks sharing a repository are resampled at cluster level

model_identity_observability.requested: gpt-6-luna (cobblemon endpoint, chat-completions); backend revision not observable
model_identity_observability.claim_limit: same public label in the same window; the schema set is the only controlled difference

quality_margin.rule: non-inferiority on quality with delta = 5 percentage points; cost compared only when quality is non-inferior

noise_and_power_plan.plan: 12 paired runs (6 tasks x 2 arms), cluster bootstrap over tasks

cache_order_design.order: randomized within blocks; cache state recorded per run

stopping_rule: stop at 12 runs; do not rerun to chase a direction
